original_historical_source.authors: August Albert Sardinas and George W. Patterson
original_historical_source.title: A necessary and sufficient condition for the unique decomposition of coded messages
original_historical_source.status: bibliographic historical provenance, not source code and not a SENS donor implementation

novelty_boundary: Pure finite labelled binary codebook property. NOT D2 parser control, NOT T5 transport/serializer, NOT SENS runtime parity. An already existing sequence-scan composition may make this library/Core-Math derived; review required.

proposals.typed_input: finite ordered sequence of (distinct nonempty symbol id, nonempty binary word), no duplicate ids
proposals.typed_output: existing D1:YES or D1:NO; invalid input BLOCK through existing typed failure
proposals.semantic_law: Decide if any two different nonempty finite sequences of identities concatenate to the same bitstream; unlike PREFIX-FREE, a nonprefix-free code may still be uniquely decipherable. Empty codebook YES. Finite fixed-point suffix construction always terminates.
positive_witnesses: [(a,0),(b,01),(c,10)] -> NO because a,c and b,a both encode 010
falsifiers: codebook [(a,0),(b,1),(c,000000)] must reject: c vs six a identities
duplicate binary encodings for different identities must reject
empty word, nonbinary character, duplicate identity must BLOCK
proposals.ownership_boundary: D10 research library/property candidate vs derived Core-Math and D2-only structural read authority; no wire-level change.

proposals.typed_output: none, or two unequal finite symbol-id lists and the same encoded word
proposals.semantic_law: For an ambiguous finite codebook, produce two genuinely different source identity sequences yielding identical concatenated binary output. Deterministic source-order BFS returns first reached witness, without claiming globally shortest bits. For unique codebook give typed absence, not made-up ambiguity.
falsifiers: returning only D1:NO without reconstructible differing sequences is not a witness
returning the same source sequence twice is invalid
unbounded guessed search depth is not a proof of uniqueness
proposals.ownership_boundary: Proof-producing projection likely derivable from the finite-code decision; explicit HOLD until D10/Core-Math review.
